disclaimer: Educational decision support only. Similar symptoms can have non-disease causes. Confirm diagnosis with a KVK, agricultural extension officer, or plant pathologist. Use only products registered for the crop and disease locally and follow the current label.

symptoms: Top leaves dry and stalk interiors turn red with white cross-bands
Stalks shrink and may smell sour
prevention: Use resistant varieties and certified seed cane
Inspect setts, sanitize tools, and rotate affected fields
treatment: No cure for systemically infected stalks
Remove clumps and never use affected cane as seed
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: A long black whip emerges from the growing point
Stalks become thin with excessive tillering
prevention: Use resistant varieties and clean treated setts
Rogue infected stools before whips release spores
treatment: Remove the entire stool inside a bag where practical
Disinfect tools and avoid ratooning affected fields
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Canes lose vigour and leaves yellow and dry
Internal tissue becomes purple-brown and pith may become hollow
prevention: Use healthy seed cane and resistant varieties
Rotate and avoid prolonged drought or waterlogging
treatment: Remove affected clumps and improve soil and water management
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Many thin pale tillers form a grass-like clump
Normal canes and internodes fail to develop
prevention: Hot-water treat setts where officially recommended and control vectors
treatment: Uproot affected stools and do not ratoon or use them as seed
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

diseases.pathogen: Sugarcane mosaic virus and related viruses
symptoms: Leaves show irregular light and dark green mosaic
Plants may be stunted with reduced cane weight
prevention: Use resistant varieties and clean seed cane
Remove volunteer hosts and manage aphid vectors
treatment: Rogue affected stools and replace infected seed sources
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails

symptoms: Ratoons show poor growth and shortened internodes without clear external signs
Small orange-red dots may occur in vascular bundles at nodes
prevention: Disinfect cutting tools and use approved hot-water treatment
treatment: Replace infected seed stocks and avoid ratooning affected fields
escalate_when: Symptoms spread rapidly or affect stems, roots, panicles, ears, bunches, bolls, or fruit
Diagnosis is uncertain, several plants are affected, or initial management fails
